verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer personal agent, but a product of this kind could plausibly offer developer SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any official SDK. Probes found no public API spec, no llms.txt, and no keyless developer surface on api.muse.ai. Muse writing its own connectors for third-party APIs is an agent feature, not an SDK for developers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
